affectedCopies: User.lastSeenAt, written by recordUserSeen (apps/web/lib/identity/last-seen.ts) from workforce sign-in (lib/govern/auth.ts) and the workforce shell layout
Read by the orphaned-approval attention source (apps/web/lib/attention/sources/orphaned-approval.ts), shown only to superusers on the Needs you inbox and the coworker opening briefing

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: one activity timestamp per workforce account, coarsened to at most one update an hour
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: Part of the User record: exported and erased with it. It holds no content, location, device or IP; only the most recent time the person used the portal.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Overwritten in place (no history kept). Surfaced only to superusers, and only as 'not used since <date>' for an account whose AI approvals are going unanswered. Not used for performance monitoring or any per-person activity report.

migration.name: 20260926030000_user_last_seen_at
migration.backfill: None. Adds a nullable column; every existing user reads NULL, meaning 'not seen since tracking began', and is stamped on their next sign-in or portal page. There is no historical sign-in record to derive a value from. IF NOT EXISTS makes a re-run harmless, so it applies cleanly against any existing data state.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code ignores the column.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the new column follows the User row's lifecycle and adds no retention obligation.

fields.reason: Coworker approvals route only to their delegating user; without a last-seen signal an operator cannot tell that the account never comes, and approvals expire unanswered (live: 193 for admin@dpf.local).
fields.provenance: BI-61DE8177; follows BI-07D21B4A (consent bound a bootstrap account)
fields.fieldPolicy: Written only by recordUserSeen, at most hourly. Read only by the superuser-gated orphaned-approval source. Never shown to non-superusers, never placed in a model prompt beyond the 'not used since' line on that card.
